title: Mandatory equipment — Wildstrubel by UTMB
publisher: UTMB World Series / Wildstrubel by UTMB
claims: The Wild 110 and Wild 70 basic kit includes a running pack, a smartphone with Swiss roaming and LiveTrail, a 15 cl cup, at least 1 litre of water, an 800 kcal food reserve, two headlamps with spare batteries, a 1.4 × 2 m survival blanket, a whistle, a 100 × 6 cm elastic bandage, a waterproof hooded jacket (10,000 mm, RET 13), full-length leg cover, a warm long-sleeved second layer of at least 180 g and ID.

The hot-weather kit adds sunglasses, a head-and-neck cover and SPF 50 sunscreen and raises the water minimum to 2 litres; the cold-weather kit adds a down third layer, protective glasses, a beanie, warm waterproof gloves, waterproof overpants and sturdy closed-toe trail shoes.

verification.note: 2026-11-09 直接抓取并读取 Wild110 & Wild70 的强制装备清单。
